environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; storytelling focus on survival; quadrants emphasize the transition from water to mud; friendly but prehistoric aesthetic.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): Tiny, translucent fish larvae with visible external gills wriggling in a cluster of bubbles attached to a submerged reed; Top-Right (Dining): The lungfish suction-feeding on a freshwater snail near the muddy bottom; Bottom-Left (Sleeping/Aestivation): The lungfish curled up inside a protective 'mud cocoon' in cracked, dry purple earth, showing how it survives the dry season; Bottom-Right (Playing/Surfacing): The lungfish poking its snout above the water's surface to take a gulp of air, creating a series of concentric ripples.
visual_logic.ground: Varies from soft, bubbly underwater mud to the hard, geometric cracks of sun-baked Anacleto claystone.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even lighting to highlight the unique 'mud cocoon' texture and the details of the 'air-gulping' behavior.
